source_evidence: Generally, the interest on municipal bonds is exempt from federal income tax. The interest may also be exempt from state and local taxes if you reside in the state where the bond is issued.
question: Misconception: Interest from every municipal bond is automatically free from all federal, state, and local taxes.
answer: Municipal bond interest is generally exempt from federal income tax, but state and local tax exemptions may depend on where you live and where the bond was issued. So, it is not accurate to assume every municipal bond is exempt from every tax.
